skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo to all targets, inflicting Direct DMG equal to 130% of Max HP. Each hit can trigger [Special Breakthrough] once and deals additional [True DMG] equal to 100% of original Max HP. Increases own [True DMG Bonus]% for 2 turns. [Special Breakthrough]: Immediately removes the target’s [Specialized Unyielding]. [True DMG]: Not affected by DMG Rate or DMG Free, and deals Direct DMG without [DMG Sharing] or [Evasion].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo to all targets, inflicting Direct DMG equal to 170% of Max HP. Each hit can trigger [Special Breakthrough] once and deals additional [True DMG] equal to 140% of original Max HP. Increases own [True DMG Bonus] by 35% for 2 turns. [Special Breakthrough]: Immediately removes the target’s [Specialized Unyielding]. [True DMG]: Not affected by DMG Rate or DMG Free, and deals Direct DMG without [DMG Sharing] or [Evasion].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Special Evasion]. Becomes immune to [Fear], [Stun], and [Special Stun]. Increases own Block Rate by 25%. [Special Evasion]: Direct DMG, DoT DMG, Received DMG, and Bonus DMG only deal 1 point of DMG per instance.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Gains 70% [Special Evasion]. Becomes immune to [Fear], [Stun], and [Special Stun]. Increases own Block Rate by 30%. [Special Evasion]: Direct DMG, DoT DMG, Received DMG, and Bonus DMG only deal 1 point of DMG per instance.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Gains 80% [Special Evasion]. Becomes immune to [Fear], [Stun], and [Special Stun]. Increases own Block Rate by 35%. [Special Evasion]: Direct DMG, DoT DMG, Received DMG, and Bonus DMG only deal 1 point of DMG per instance.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Upon entering battle, gains [Non-Crit Undying] for 6 turns. Permanently gains 100% [CRIT Resistance]. When triggering a Block, reflects [True DMG] equal to 200% of own Max HP to the attacker. [Non-Crit Undying]: While active, fatal DMG from non-critical hits will not defeat the character, and HP is retained at 70%. Additionally, blocks up to 6 instances of fatal DMG from critical hits. Only the first hit of an attack determines whether it is a critical hit.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Upon entering battle, gains [Non-Crit Undying] for 6 turns. Permanently gains 100% [CRIT Resistance]. When triggering a Block, reflects [True DMG] equal to 300% of own Max HP to the attacker. [Non-Crit Undying]: While active, fatal DMG from non-critical hits will not defeat the character, and HP is retained at 100%. Additionally, blocks up to 9 instances of fatal DMG from critical hits. Only the first hit of an attack determines whether it is a critical hit.

effects.desc: Survive non-fatal attacks (hold about 20% HP without collapsing) and resist a limited number of fatal attacks.
[Faint's] powerful and final stun, which can only be removed with specialized debuffs.
The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Survival buff that, when present, prevents the unit from being crited and cannot die, retaining 70% of its health for the duration of the effect.
Unfavorable effects remove the enemy's invulnerability/immunity so they can be destroyed.
This type of bonus damage is dealt on top of attacks, is reduced by Evasion-type effects, and can be immune after a certain number of turns.
The stun control effect renders the target unable to act and reduces its overall damage immunity by 30%.
